articles.title: B Architecture admission 2026 registration extended until July 28 as Maharashtra CET Cell revises application schedule
articles.summary: The Maharashtra CET Cell has extended the registration deadline for the B Architecture centralised admission process for the 2026-27 academic session to July 28, 2026. Candidates can complete online registration and upload documents until 5:00 PM on the revised deadline.

articles.title: Rajasthan JET 2026 result expected soon as SKRAU prepares merit ranks and counselling process for admissions
articles.summary: Rajasthan JET 2026 result: The Rajasthan JET 2026 result is expected between July 27 and August 5 following the release of the final answer key by SKRAU, Bikaner. Candidates will be able to download their scorecards from the official website using their login credentials.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu supplementary results 2026: SSLC and HSC results expected soon at tnresults.nic.in
articles.summary: TN 10th 11th 12th Supplementary results: The Tamil Nadu Class 10 and Class 12 supplementary examination results 2026 for regular candidates are expected in the last week of July. Students will be able to download provisional marksheets from the official DGE and TN Results portals using their registration number and date of birth.

articles.title: MCC NEET UG 2026 counselling schedule expected soon as MCC prepares to release admission timeline and seat details
articles.summary: The MCC is expected to release the NEET UG 2026 counselling schedule following the declaration of Re-NEET UG 2026 results. Tentative timelines indicate Round 1 registration in early August, with subsequent counselling rounds extending until October.
